policy: Each entry is a single-output contract that does not state how its value is obtained. The list may only shrink: an entry that no longer violates must be deleted in the same commit as the fix, so the removal appears in the diff. Adding an entry requires a new measurement and is not how a violation is silenced.

measured_return_kinds.method: ran each baselined contract's own example in the packaged interpreter and classified the object its assignments produce; the probe script is described below so it can be rerun
measured_return_kinds.probe: assign-and-inspect: exec the example, take the first assigned name, classify by module/type
measured_return_kinds.summary: 47 + 24 + 3 + 3 + 1 = 78 have a determinate non-mapping return, so a channel sentence can be written from this measurement. 7 return a mapping (real ambiguity, belongs with T-2026-1203), and 7 could not be classified and need a manual read. No contract text was changed in this measurement; the baseline only gained a per-entry classification.
measured_return_kinds.why_no_mass_edit: A uniform 'returned positionally' sentence would be false for the 7 mapping-returning assets and unverified for the 7 undetermined ones. Writing it anyway would trade a visible debt for an invisible false statement.
